name: Mirei
source: A friendly and outgoing girl who grew up at the same orphanage as [url=https://vndb.org/c147243]Hikari[/url], as well as Hikari's first and closest friend. Her kindness was what inspired Hikari to become more caring about others, as well.
translation: A friendly and outgoing girl who grew up at the same orphanage as [url=https://vndb.org/c147243]Hikari[/url], as well as Hikari's first and closest friend. Her kindness was what inspired Hikari to become more caring about others, as well.
